name: Dirge Quikcleave
summary: Inside Gadgetzan's inn, Dirge Quikcleave holds court as a goblin culinary master and vendor. His inventive dishes are renowned across Azeroth, and seasoned chefs come to him to master artisan cooking.

sections.title: Master of the Cleaver
sections.body: In dusty Gadgetzan, Dirge Quikcleave serves drinks and meat to travelers parched by the Tanaris sands. Though his kitchen is in a frontier tavern, he claims to be Azeroth's greatest living culinary artist. Cooking trainers in cities send their most promising students to him when ordinary lessons are spent. Dirge's demanding recipes call for unusual ingredients, from giant clam meat and eggs for his Clamlette creations to exotic beasts from distant shores.

sections.title: Exotic Flavors and Shady Favors
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave pairs a gourmand's bravado with a goblin's eye for business. Across Kalimdor, he keeps contacts with eccentric figures and seeks out dangerous culinary ventures. Those who bring him fierce beast cuts, such as meat from the monstrous chimaeroks of Feralas's Isle of Dread, can receive hearty recipes fit to sustain champions on perilous journeys. They must not ask too many questions about Dirge's private dealings.

faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave is a goblin chef and provisioner inside the inn at Gadgetzan, Tanaris. Renowned as one of Azeroth's finest culinary practitioners, he teaches aspiring cooks to hone their craft toward artisan mastery.

faq.q: Where can Dirge Quikcleave be found?
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave can be found inside the tavern in Gadgetzan, a Steamwheedle cartel boomtown in the northern dunes of Tanaris.

faq.q: Why do cooking trainers send adventurers to him?
faq.answer: Cooking trainers in the capital cities can take an apprentice only so far. When a cook reaches an expert threshold, they send them to Dirge in Gadgetzan through 'To Gadgetzan You Go!' to prove their worth and unlock artisan cooking.

faq.q: What dishes is Dirge famous for?
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave is known for Clamlette Surprise, a savory omelet made from giant clam meat and eggs, hearty wolf steaks, and his potent Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops.

angles.text: As an ambitious chef, you can seek Dirge Quikcleave's artisan instruction. He tests your skill with his signature clamlette recipes before granting master status.
As an aspiring Horde gourmand, you are sent straight from Orgrimmar by its trainers to seek Dirge's culinary tutelage in the Tanaris desert.
